name: An Average Campaign [Alpha v0.5.0]
desc:
>> An Average Campaign is intended to be played with 3 - 4 players but supports 1 - 5 players <<

Embark in a classic, simplistic roguelike adventure full of inside jokes, references, and other random stuff.  

This game is intended to be difficult and may be frustrating to some people. Losing a run should be expected and information is key.

Inspired by Dungeons & Dragons, Arcane Lineage, and Slay The Spire.

Credits: 
huhuzh - Scripting, UI
Kario777 - Modeling
Yuml_I - Modeling
FringleMeench - Animations, VFX

Note: This game is in Alpha phase and is currently in heavy development. Some features are incomplete and bugs that may stall/freeze your game may appear.
